project.name: gsd-browser
project.goal: Migrate gsd MCP server to FastMCP v2 Option B with SEP-1686 tasks, Docket/Redis task queue, distributed artifacts (S3-compatible + Redis index), and tenant/subject authorization boundaries.

drift_gate.description: Contract schemas are generated from Pydantic and must match committed JSON Schemas.
drift_gate.export_command: cd gsd-browser && uv sync --frozen && PYTHONPATH=./src uv run python tools/export_contract_schemas.py
drift_gate.enforcement_test: cd gsd-browser && uv sync --frozen && PYTHONPATH=./src uv run python -m pytest -q tests/test_exported_jsonschema_in_sync.py

when_to_consult: If implementing a FastMCP v2 runtime integration and an API behavior is unclear after reading the canonical spec and the plan docs.
If a FastMCP v2 task/cancellation/progress behavior differs from expectations and you need upstream details or examples.
If Docket/Redis configuration details are unclear and need upstream confirmation.

repos.use_for: FastMCP v2 runtime, tasks/background tasks, Docket integration, HTTP transport behavior.

deepwiki.rule: Consult local repo docs first; only consult DeepWiki when local docs do not answer the question. Record the outcome in the task notes (what was asked and what was learned).

global_rules.no_spec_drift: Implementation MUST follow `gsd-browser/docs/api/FAST_MCP_V2_CANONICAL_SPEC.md`. If changes are required, update canonical spec + MCP_TOOLS + contracts + exported JSON schemas in the same PR/commit series.

phases.name: Determinism + Repo Gates
phases.goal: Ensure schema generation and tests are deterministic across environments.

tasks.title: Pin schema generation environment

references.purpose: Pydantic version pin for stable JSON schema generation.
Pinned dependency lockfile for reproducible schema outputs.

tasks.kickoff_prompt:
You are executing task I0.1. Objective: make JSON schema export deterministic. Steps: (1) Verify `gsd-browser/pyproject.toml` pins Pydantic to a stable minor series; (2) ensure `gsd-browser/uv.lock` is updated and committed; (3) confirm drift gate passes with `uv sync --frozen`.

Required commands:
- `cd gsd-browser && uv sync --frozen`
- `cd gsd-browser && PYTHONPATH=./src uv run python tools/export_contract_schemas.py`
- `cd gsd-browser && PYTHONPATH=./src uv run python -m pytest -q tests/test_exported_jsonschema_in_sync.py`

If schema output differs across environments, tighten version pins until stable.

acceptance_criteria.statement: `uv sync --frozen` succeeds from a clean checkout using `gsd-browser/uv.lock`.
Schema export drift gate passes in the pinned environment.

commands: cd gsd-browser && PYTHONPATH=./src uv run python tools/export_contract_schemas.py
cd gsd-browser && PYTHONPATH=./src uv run python -m pytest -q tests/test_exported_jsonschema_in_sync.py

acceptance_criteria.statement: If `gsd-browser/src/gsd_browser/contracts/v1.py` changes, updated schemas under `gsd-browser/docs/api/jsonschema/` are committed in the same change set.

commands: cd gsd-browser && PYTHONPATH=./src uv run python -m pytest -q tests/test_exported_jsonschema_in_sync.py

phases.name: Framework Migration (No Behavior Change)
phases.goal: Swap runtime from official SDK FastMCP wrapper to `jlowin/fastmcp` v2 without changing tool semantics.

tasks.title: Add FastMCP v2 server entrypoint (stdio)

references.purpose: Migration boundary; must update once v2 runtime is implemented.
Target runtime semantics; do not change behavior in I1.

tasks.kickoff_prompt:
You are executing task I1.1. Objective: add a FastMCP v2 stdio entrypoint that exposes the same tools without changing semantics.

Read first:
- `gsd-browser/docs/api/STATUS.md`
- `gsd-browser/docs/api/MCP_TOOLS.md`

Rules:
- No contract or semantic changes in this task.
- If a behavior change is required, stop and update the canonical spec first.

Validation:
- `make -C gsd-browser lint`
- `make -C gsd-browser test`

acceptance_criteria.statement: A FastMCP v2 stdio server can start and register all tools currently exposed by the SDK server.
All existing tests pass with the v2 entrypoint enabled.

tasks.title: Port tool policy + registration to FastMCP v2

references.purpose: Tool names, inputs, and output schema references.

tasks.kickoff_prompt:
You are executing task I1.2. Objective: ensure tool registration/policy matches existing behavior under FastMCP v2.

If you are unsure about how FastMCP v2 represents tool metadata, consult DeepWiki `jlowin/fastmcp` with a targeted question, then record what you learned in the task notes.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Tool list and names match `gsd-browser/docs/api/MCP_TOOLS.md` exactly.

phases.name: Tasks End-to-End (SEP-1686 + Docket + Ownership)
phases.goal: Implement FastMCP v2 background tasks for long tools, with ownership authZ, progress, and cancellation semantics.

tasks.title: Implement TaskOwnershipStore (Redis) + enforcement on tasks endpoints

references.purpose: §3.2 Task ownership record; §2.2 task authZ rules.

tasks.kickoff_prompt:
You are executing task I2.1.

Objective: Implement TaskOwnershipRecord persistence and enforce it on `tasks/get`, `tasks/result`, and `tasks/cancel`.

Read first:
- `gsd-browser/docs/api/FAST_MCP_V2_CANONICAL_SPEC.md` (§2.2, §3.2)

Rules:
- All authZ behavior must match canonical spec.
- Non-enumerability must be preserved (not-found semantics).

Validation:
- Add unit tests for cross-tenant denial.
- Run `make -C gsd-browser lint` and `make -C gsd-browser test`.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Task ownership record is written before returning a Task response; failures abort the call per canonical spec.
`tasks/get|result|cancel` reject access from a mismatched tenant/subject with not-found semantics.

tasks.title: Mark long tools as task-required and implement progress notifications

references.purpose: §3.1 task-required tools; §6 progress conventions; §3.4 poll interval.

tasks.kickoff_prompt:
You are executing task I2.2.

Objective: enforce `taskSupport="required"` for long tools and emit progress per canonical spec.

Do not invent progress message formats; use the canonical `phase=... step=... note=...` format and the max 200-char note bound.

If FastMCP v2 progress APIs are unclear, consult DeepWiki `jlowin/fastmcp` and record the answer.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Invoking `web_eval_agent`, `web_task_agent`, and `web_task_agent_github` returns a Task object (not an immediate result).
Progress notifications are emitted at start, per agent step, and on terminal states.

tasks.title: Implement cooperative cancellation with resource cleanup
tasks.kickoff_prompt:
You are executing task I2.3.

Objective: implement cooperative cancellation that stops work between steps and releases resources in `finally`.

Add tests that cancel mid-run and confirm task transitions promptly and resources are closed.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Cancelling an in-flight task transitions it to cancelled promptly and stops further work.

phases.name: Distributed Artifact Store (S3 + Redis Index + Cleanup)
phases.goal: Persist artifacts to S3-compatible storage and index in Redis; retrieval tools read from Redis and optionally deliver via inline/presigned modes.

tasks.title: Implement S3 client wrapper + presign (SeaweedFS/AWS S3 compatible)

references.purpose: §4.2 key scheme + encryption; §4.4 presigned URL policy; §8.6 store config.

tasks.kickoff_prompt:
You are executing task I3.1.

Objective: implement S3-compatible interactions (PUT/HEAD/GET via presign/DELETE) honoring:
- key scheme: tenants/{tenant}/subjects/{subject}/sessions/{session}/...
- Cache-Control: no-store
- encryption-at-rest policy via `GSD_S3_SSE_MODE`

If a behavior is unclear across S3-compatible stores, consult ADR-0009 and (only if needed) DeepWiki `jlowin/fastmcp` for upstream examples; do not invent semantics that contradict the canonical spec.

acceptance_criteria.statement: S3 wrapper supports upload + delete + presign; configuration is validated at startup.

tasks.title: Implement Redis artifact index + cleanup lock
tasks.kickoff_prompt:
You are executing task I3.2.

Objective: implement the ArtifactIndexRecord meta + session zsets and cleanup behavior exactly per canonical spec.

Critical requirements:
- atomicity sequence meta(pending) → upload → finalize(ready + zset)
- cleanup leader lock: TTL expiry only (do not delete lock key)
- idempotency rules exactly as specified

Write tests for partial failures and cleanup idempotency.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Artifact write atomicity and cleanup idempotency behaviors match canonical spec and are covered by tests.

tasks.title: Wire screenshots to distributed store and implement delivery-mode matrix

references.purpose: §5.1 delivery mode matrix, id/key invariants, and pairing rules.
Tool input/output schema and delivery mode docs.

tasks.kickoff_prompt:
You are executing task I3.3.

Objective: persist screenshots to the distributed store and make `get_screenshots` read from Redis index.

Must-haves:
- delivery-mode matrix must match canonical spec
- `screenshots[].artifact.key == screenshots[].id`
- timestamps in payload are epoch seconds; internal indices use ms

Validation:
- run schema export drift gate if any contract changes.
- `make -C gsd-browser test`

acceptance_criteria.statement: `get_screenshots` behavior matches the canonical delivery-mode matrix and pairing invariants.

tasks.title: Wire run-events to distributed store and enforce canonical filter semantics

references.purpose: §5.2 filter semantics, invalid input behavior, bounds.

tasks.kickoff_prompt:
You are executing task I3.4.

Objective: persist run-events chunks to the distributed store and make `get_run_events` read from Redis/S3 with canonical filtering semantics.

Must-haves:
- `event_types`, `has_error`, `from_timestamp`, `include_details` semantics exactly match canonical spec
- `events` bounded to 200
- timestamps are epoch seconds in payload

Validation:
- `make -C gsd-browser test`

acceptance_criteria.statement: `get_run_events` filtering, bounds, and invalid-input behavior match canonical spec and are covered by tests.
